hooks.name: Rust Delivery Intake
hooks.description: Classifies non-trivial Rust work and directs the agent to the required specialist workflow.

action.prompt: For a non-trivial Rust Factory change (new brick, public API, adapter, dependency, concurrency, safety, or persistence change), first identify the affected crate(s), whether a GitHub issue tracks it or why none is needed, and the applicable gates in `.kiro/steering/rust-delivery-workflow.md`. Follow that sequence: context, rust-factory-sme approval, implementation, QA, security, final architecture approval, then `make check`. For a trivial documentation-only or mechanical rename, use the scaled-down workflow. Do not claim specialist approval without invoking the required reviewer.
